title: Auto Loans: APR discount amounts, discount cap and APR floor
content:
# Auto Loans: APR discount amounts, discount cap and APR floor

This parameter card covers the rate-discount settings of each Auto Loans product at PCB: the size of the autopay discount and of the checking relationship discount, which checking tiers earn the relationship discount, the most all discounts together may take off the APR, the APR below which discounts never take the rate, and whether cancelling autopay removes the autopay discount.

## Meaning of each setting

- **Autopay discount**: percentage points off the APR while autopay from a PCB checking account is enrolled.
- **Relationship discount**: percentage points off the APR when the borrower held a qualifying checking tier at funding.
- **Qualifying checking tiers**: the official checking tier names that earn the relationship discount.
- **Discount cap**: the most percentage points that all discounts together can take off the APR.
- **APR floor**: the APR, in percent, below which discounts never take the rate.
- **Removed on cancellation**: whether cancelling autopay removes the autopay discount (yes or no).

## Settings by product

| Auto Loans product | Autopay discount (points) | Relationship discount (points) | Qualifying checking tiers | Discount cap (points) | APR floor (percent) | Autopay discount removed on cancellation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 0.25 | 0.25 | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 0.50 | 4.49 | yes |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 0.25 | 0.25 | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 0.50 | 4.49 | yes |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 0.25 | 0.25 | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 0.50 | 4.49 | yes |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 0.25 | 0.25 | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 0.50 | 4.49 | yes |
| New Vehicle Loan | 0.25 | 0.25 | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 0.50 | 3.99 | yes |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 0.25 | 0.25 | Premier Checking, Private Client Checking | 0.50 | 3.49 | yes |

## Quick answers

**Which checking tiers earn the relationship discount on an Auto Loans product?** Only Premier Checking and Private Client Checking, on every product.

**Do the floors differ by product?** Yes: 4.49 percent on the Used Vehicle, Certified Pre-Owned, Auto Refinance and Lease Buyout Loans; 3.99 percent on the New Vehicle Loan; 3.49 percent on the Green Vehicle Loan.

**Does any product keep the autopay discount after autopay is cancelled?** No. Every product is set to remove it on cancellation.

## Lookup illustration (hypothetical)

A Green Vehicle Loan reads: autopay discount 0.25 points, relationship discount 0.25 points, a cap of 0.50 points on the two together, and a floor of 3.49 percent. The same lookup for a Lease Buyout Loan differs only in the floor, 4.49 percent.
